method: Analyst estimates for fictional-data prototype suitability; not measured ROI or clinical effectiveness.

candidates.title: Medical record summary
candidates.adaptation: The HHS entry concerns claims review. This prototype adapts document condensation to clinician-reviewed records; it gives no diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
candidates.pain: Reviewing long medical records takes time and makes supporting evidence hard to locate.
candidates.workflow: Create a dated summary with links to the supplied record passages.
candidates.demo_input: Three fictional visit notes and a referral letter.
candidates.demo_output: A chronology, missing-information list and passage references.
candidates.metric: Summary completeness and incorrect statements per record.

candidates.title: Patient data redaction
candidates.adaptation: Adapted from HHS health-record PII detection. The prototype is a review aid and does not certify anonymisation.
candidates.pain: Identifiers can appear unexpectedly inside free-text health data.
candidates.workflow: Highlight possible identifiers and propose redactions for manual review.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic notes with deliberately inserted names, addresses and identifiers.
candidates.demo_output: Marked text, proposed redacted copy and a review log.
candidates.metric: Missed identifiers and incorrectly removed useful text.

candidates.title: Referral and document intake
candidates.adaptation: The HHS entry concerns case creation from scanned requests. Patient referral routing is a proposed local adaptation, not an HHS deployment claim.
candidates.pain: Staff manually create cases from incoming documents and requests.
candidates.workflow: Extract administrative fields, propose a case record and flag missing information.
candidates.demo_input: Fictional referral forms and an explicit required-field checklist.
candidates.demo_output: A proposed intake record and exceptions for staff approval.
candidates.metric: Correct field extraction and missed required fields.

candidates.title: Clinical guidance search
candidates.adaptation: HHS entries concern search and IIS or programme guidance. Adapted to approved clinic material; no independent clinical advice.
candidates.pain: Staff lose time locating current approved guidance across documents.
candidates.workflow: Search a small approved guidance library and return cited passages.
candidates.demo_input: Fictional clinic procedures and approved administrative FAQs.
candidates.demo_output: A cited answer with source version and an unable-to-answer state.
candidates.metric: Citation accuracy and time to find the approved passage.

candidates.title: Patient information translation
candidates.adaptation: HHS reports translation support in Smartling. This is an adaptation to patient communication, not evidence of medical translation accuracy.
candidates.pain: Approved patient information may be inaccessible in the reader’s language.
candidates.workflow: Draft a translation of approved administrative information for bilingual review.
candidates.demo_input: Fictional appointment preparation and access instructions.
candidates.demo_output: A translation draft and a list of terms requiring verification.
candidates.metric: Meaning preserved and critical terms checked by a qualified reviewer.

candidates.title: Patient complaint analysis
candidates.adaptation: HHS examples concern beneficiary complaints. Adapted to service improvement; the tool does not decide complaint outcomes.
candidates.pain: Large complaint volumes obscure recurring service problems.
candidates.workflow: Group fictional complaints by theme and cite representative passages.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic service complaints without real personal details.
candidates.demo_output: A theme summary, examples and proposed follow-up questions.
candidates.metric: Theme agreement with staff and incorrectly grouped complaints.

candidates.title: Healthcare service navigation
candidates.adaptation: Adapted from ELMO and programme knowledge-base support. No entitlement or eligibility determination.
candidates.pain: Users need help navigating service systems and reporting requirements.
candidates.workflow: Explain an approved administrative process and provide the next reviewable step.
candidates.demo_input: A fictional service manual and system navigation guide.
candidates.demo_output: A cited navigation answer with staff handoff when unclear.
candidates.metric: Correct next-step guidance and successful handoffs.

candidates.title: Health survey response quality
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by SANDS. Reviewers decide whether to retain responses; the tool does not infer respondents’ health status.
candidates.pain: Open-ended survey nonresponses are expensive to review manually.
candidates.workflow: Flag blank, irrelevant or ambiguous responses against a supplied rubric.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic health-survey responses and a review rubric.
candidates.demo_output: A quality review queue with reason codes and original response text.
candidates.metric: Agreement with manual review and useful responses incorrectly flagged.

candidates.title: Laboratory procedure search
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by the DLS AI Assistant pilot. US CLIA/ISO references in the original inventory are not automatically Australian requirements.
candidates.pain: Laboratory staff need quick access to procedure and quality guidance.
candidates.workflow: Retrieve cited passages from an approved laboratory procedure pack.
candidates.demo_input: Fictional SOPs and laboratory quality FAQs.
candidates.demo_output: A referenced response with document version.
candidates.metric: Source accuracy and missing information identified.

candidates.title: Health benefits document comparison
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by Marketplace benefits assistance and SBC review. Local benefits must be supplied; the prototype does not determine coverage.
candidates.pain: Benefits documents can contain inconsistent wording or numerical values.
candidates.workflow: Compare two fictional benefits documents and identify differences.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic benefit summaries and explicitly supplied policy clauses.
candidates.demo_output: A difference table with supporting quotes.
candidates.metric: Discrepancy accuracy and unsupported coverage claims.

candidates.title: Care quality document review
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by CASA nursing-home survey review. The demo flags evidence for review; it makes no regulatory finding.
candidates.pain: Reviewing care-quality reports against documented standards is time-consuming.
candidates.workflow: Compare fictional quality observations with an explicit checklist.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic care-quality observations and a supplied local checklist.
candidates.demo_output: A cited checklist review with issues for qualified assessment.
candidates.metric: Missed checklist gaps and reviewer agreement.

candidates.title: Claims evidence preparation
candidates.adaptation: US Medicare and Marketplace examples need Australian process adaptation. No automated eligibility, payment or coverage decision.
candidates.pain: Medical evidence for a claim must be manually located and cross-referenced.
candidates.workflow: Assemble supplied evidence against an explicit fictional claim checklist.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic claim packet, record excerpts and declared review requirements.
candidates.demo_output: An evidence index and missing-document questions.
candidates.metric: Evidence retrieval accuracy and unsupported assertions.

candidates.title: Health application completeness
candidates.adaptation: Adapted from Marketplace data-quality checks. No eligibility determination, automatic outreach or source-system change.
candidates.pain: Missing or inconsistent application information delays the consumer feedback cycle.
candidates.workflow: Check a fictional application and draft requests for missing information.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic health-service applications and required-field rules.
candidates.demo_output: A completeness checklist and a draft follow-up message.
candidates.metric: Missed required fields and unnecessary follow-up requests.

candidates.title: Health plan communication review
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by Medicare Part C/D marketing review. Local rules must be supplied; no regulatory compliance certification.
candidates.pain: Health plan materials can contain inconsistent or unclear statements.
candidates.workflow: Review fictional materials against a supplied communication checklist.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic brochures, benefit statements and a review checklist.
candidates.demo_output: A cited issue table and wording suggestions for approval.
candidates.metric: Checklist gaps detected and unjustified findings.

candidates.title: Health programme data quality
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by HIV DQS. Generalised to fictional programme reporting; no real HIV data or automatic source changes.
candidates.pain: Submitted programme datasets contain errors requiring manual cleanup.
candidates.workflow: Check required fields and logical constraints, then propose corrections for approval.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic programme submissions with deliberately inserted data errors.
candidates.demo_output: A field-level issue list and proposed changes with an audit trail.
candidates.metric: Errors detected and incorrect corrections.

candidates.title: Immunisation reporting explorer
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by Databricks Genie immunisation insights. Queries a fixed local synthetic dataset; no individual vaccination recommendation.
candidates.pain: Aggregate immunisation reporting requires specialised queries and data preparation.
candidates.workflow: Translate a plain-language question into a visible query against a synthetic dataset.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic aggregate immunisation data and a documented data dictionary.
candidates.demo_output: A reviewable query, result table and chart.
candidates.metric: Query correctness and consistency with manually calculated totals.

candidates.title: Prevention programme follow-up
candidates.adaptation: Adapted from National DPP organisation risk assessment. No patient-level risk prediction or programme eligibility decision.
candidates.pain: Programme teams need to identify organisations missing participation or performance milestones.
candidates.workflow: Check organisation-level milestones and draft follow-up questions for staff review.
candidates.demo_input: Fictional programme enrolment counts, milestones and declared rules.
candidates.demo_output: A review queue with missed milestones and supporting evidence.
candidates.metric: Correct flags and inappropriate escalations.

candidates.title: Public health evidence brief
candidates.adaptation: Adapted from Deep Research for Public Health. Fixed supplied sources rather than autonomous policy or legal recommendations.
candidates.pain: Staff need timely, traceable summaries across complex public health information.
candidates.workflow: Build a concise brief from a fixed source pack with citations and evidence gaps.
candidates.demo_input: Approved public health excerpts and an explicit question.
candidates.demo_output: A cited draft brief distinguishing facts, uncertainties and proposed follow-up.
candidates.metric: Citation support and omissions against the source pack.

candidates.title: Synthetic health survey sandbox
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by NCHS synthetic survey research. Uses invented inputs only and makes no privacy guarantee or claim of equivalent analytic utility.
candidates.pain: Teams need realistic test data without exposing survey participants.
candidates.workflow: Generate fictional survey examples from a declared schema and compare aggregate properties.
candidates.demo_input: A fictional survey schema and manually declared distributions.
candidates.demo_output: Synthetic test rows and a validation report.
candidates.metric: Schema validity and aggregate distribution differences.

candidates.title: Vaccine access evidence screening
candidates.adaptation: Follows the inventory’s vaccine-access abstract screening workflow. Human reviewers make inclusion decisions; no vaccination recommendation is generated.
candidates.pain: Reviewers must screen many abstracts to find evidence about vaccine access.
candidates.workflow: Screen supplied abstracts against explicit inclusion criteria and cite the matching text.
candidates.demo_input: A small public abstract pack and vaccine-access screening criteria.
candidates.demo_output: A candidate reading list with reasons to include or exclude each abstract.
candidates.metric: Agreement with manual screening and missed relevant abstracts.

candidates.title: Medication document consistency
candidates.adaptation: Adapted from Rx formulary integrity review. The demo does not verify dosages, prescribe or recommend medication changes.
candidates.pain: Medication-related documents can contain inconsistent entries across sources.
candidates.workflow: Compare supplied text entries and flag discrepancies for pharmacist review.
candidates.demo_input: Fictional medication lists and reference documents.
candidates.demo_output: A discrepancy report quoting both sources.
candidates.metric: Discrepancies found and false positives.

candidates.title: Adverse event coding review
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by CDC adverse drug event surveillance. This prototype proposes reviewed codes rather than estimating clinical event probabilities or diagnosing patients.
candidates.pain: Manually coding emergency-visit narratives slows adverse event surveillance.
candidates.workflow: Suggest surveillance labels from fictional narratives and explain the evidence for review.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic emergency visit descriptions and supplied coding definitions.
candidates.demo_output: Proposed labels, cited evidence and an uncertain-case queue.
candidates.metric: Coding agreement and missed adverse-event examples.

candidates.title: Care quality visit planning
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by HRSA high-risk health-centre identification. No enforcement, eligibility or automated visit scheduling; reviewers make decisions.
candidates.pain: Planning site visits requires reviewing many quality indicators across centres.
candidates.workflow: Compare synthetic centre metrics against declared indicators and prepare a review queue.
candidates.demo_input: Fictional centre-level quality metrics and explicit scheduling criteria.
candidates.demo_output: A prioritisation worksheet with reasons and missing-data flags.
candidates.metric: Agreement with the declared criteria and incorrectly flagged centres.

candidates.title: Clinical AI validation checklist
candidates.adaptation: Inspired by the NEF local CDS validation project. This demo evaluates fictional outputs; it does not validate a clinical system for use.
candidates.pain: Locally deployed decision support needs evaluation against suitable reference labels.
candidates.workflow: Compare supplied fictional predictions with reference labels and display review metrics.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic labelled test cases and declared acceptance thresholds.
candidates.demo_output: An accuracy and error breakdown, with limitations for governance review.
candidates.metric: Error rates by test group and reproducibility.

candidates.title: Health record matching review
candidates.adaptation: Adapted from NCHS record linkage. No automatic merge, clinical identity assertion or production patient linkage.
candidates.pain: Linking records across datasets requires careful matching and duplicate review.
candidates.workflow: Propose candidate record pairs using declared matching fields for manual confirmation.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic records with known duplicates and deliberate near matches.
candidates.demo_output: Candidate pairs, match reasons and unresolved conflicts.
candidates.metric: False merges and missed true matches.

candidates.title: Infection response note categorisation
candidates.adaptation: Based on CDC AMR response-data categorisation. It does not diagnose infection, recommend antibiotics or decide infection-control action.
candidates.pain: Free-text antimicrobial resistance response notes are hard to clean and analyse.
candidates.workflow: Propose categories for fictional response notes and preserve the supporting text.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic infection-response logs and a supplied category list.
candidates.demo_output: A categorised table with ambiguous entries marked for review.
candidates.metric: Category agreement and missed response details.

candidates.title: Injury surveillance trend dashboard
candidates.adaptation: The HHS system nowcasts national injury deaths. The initial prototype is descriptive; a validated forecasting model would be separate work.
candidates.pain: Delayed injury reporting makes current trends difficult to interpret.
candidates.workflow: Visualise supplied aggregate weekly counts and flag incomplete reporting periods.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic aggregate injury counts with reporting-delay metadata.
candidates.demo_output: A trend dashboard separating observed values from any experimental estimates.
candidates.metric: Trend calculation accuracy and uncertainty coverage on held-out synthetic data.

candidates.title: Outbreak investigation summary
candidates.adaptation: Adapted from SEDRIC summarisation and receipt reading. It makes no outbreak attribution or public health action decision.
candidates.pain: Outbreak investigators must combine receipts, interview notes and shared case information.
candidates.workflow: Extract food purchases and summarise the supplied investigation timeline with citations.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic receipts and fictional interview notes.
candidates.demo_output: A purchase table, chronology and unresolved investigator questions.
candidates.metric: Extraction accuracy and unsupported connections.

candidates.title: Patient safety report assistance
candidates.adaptation: Adapted from the FDA Safety Reporting Portal chatbot for human healthcare reporting only. Does not submit reports or judge causality.
candidates.pain: Reporters can struggle to select a form and provide complete adverse-event information.
candidates.workflow: Explain supplied form options and identify missing report fields for staff review.
candidates.demo_input: A fictional incident, form catalogue and required-field checklist.
candidates.demo_output: A suggested form and a report draft with missing fields highlighted.
candidates.metric: Correct form selection and report completeness.

candidates.title: Treatment access barrier review
candidates.adaptation: Adapted from the buprenorphine discontinuation project. No inference of substance use, treatment advice or individual risk prediction.
candidates.pain: Service teams need to understand documented reasons for treatment discontinuation.
candidates.workflow: Extract explicitly stated access barriers from fictional notes and group them for review.
candidates.demo_input: Synthetic treatment journey notes with stated transport, access or scheduling barriers.
candidates.demo_output: A cited barrier summary with unknown reasons left unresolved.
candidates.metric: Extraction agreement and reasons invented by the tool.
